name: Plangine
author: Worse Code
description: Plangine 1a is a Tkinter-based 2D game plugin with player and object entities, keyboard or automatic movement, window-edge behavior, entry triggers, and a playable Tetris demo mode.
example: Plangine-load plangine; planginestarthere; createwindow]800x600]bg white]textfont Arial; create-entity_player]50,50]moveto-wasd-arrow; planginend
